title: Payments
subheading: Manage tuition payments, overdue invoices and agent-led recovery in one place.
notSetUp: Payments isn't set up in this database yet. Run the payments SQL file in Supabase (see the setup steps), then reload this page.

mode.live: Live: Xero, Gmail and SMS connected

demoNote: Demo mode. These families and invoices are fictional. Xero, Gmail and SMS aren't connected, so no message is sent and no real accounting record changes. Refreshing the page starts the demo again.

kpi.label: Payments at a glance
kpi.eligibleNote: Overdue and not protected by an extension, dispute or plan
kpi.recoveredNote: Verified in Xero after a Compass reminder
kpi.recoveredNoteDemo: Verified after a Compass reminder (simulated in demo)

overview.protectedNote_one: {{count}} family with an extension or dispute
overview.protectedNote_other: {{count}} families with an extension or dispute

agent.title: Autonomous Payment Recovery
agent.text: Scan every enrolled student's Xero invoices, check Gmail for existing arrangements and prepare personalised SMS and email reminders for eligible parents.

last.partial: Last scan finished with a failed check: {{families}} eligible families.
last.failed: Last scan stopped because a check failed.

invoices.searchPlaceholder: Search by invoice, student or billing contact

scan.title: One-Click Accounting Scan
scan.text: Compass runs all five checks in order. Nothing is sent and no record changes during the scan.
scan.failed: The scan couldn't finish. Try again in a moment.
scan.partial: The scan finished, but Gmail couldn't be checked. No family can be cleared for reminders until it is.
scan.stopped: The scan stopped because a check failed. No family was marked eligible.

step.families: Match students to family billing contacts
step.gmail: Check Gmail for extensions and disputes

stepNote.xero: Invoices, contacts, due dates and payments
stepNote.families: Invoices grouped by the person who pays
stepNote.rules: Days overdue, minimum balance and protected accounts

families.title: Overdue Invoices by Family
families.text: Invoices are grouped by the person who pays, so a parent with two children gets one reminder. Protected accounts can't be selected.
families.includeStudents: Also send a note to students where permission is verified
families.studentRule: Student notes never mention amounts or invoices, and only go to students whose family has agreed.

messages.title: Personalised Drafts
messages.text: Compass wrote one message per person and channel, with the right names, invoices and amounts. Preview, edit or leave out any of them.
messages.none: No messages could be prepared. Check the contact details and permissions of the chosen families.
messages.subject: Subject

approval.title: Owner Approval
approval.text: One approval covers the whole batch. Compass checks balances, permissions and arrangements again just before anything goes.

check.permissions: Only channels each family has agreed to
check.duplicates: One message per email address or phone number
check.students: Students only with verified permission, and no billing details
check.spam: Every SMS names the business and offers an opt-out (Spam Act 2003)
check.recheck: Paid invoices and new extensions or disputes are dropped at send time

approval.demoWarning: Demo mode: approving simulates the send. Nobody receives a message and Xero isn't changed.
approval.confirm_one: I've reviewed this message and approve sending it.
approval.confirm_other: I've reviewed these {{count}} messages and approve sending them.
approval.ownerOnly: Only the owner can approve and send payment reminders. The batch is saved here for the owner to review.

monitor.title: Delivery and Monitoring
monitor.text: Compass checks Gmail and SMS for replies and Xero for payments, stops reminders once an invoice is paid and escalates families your rules say need a decision.
monitor.textDemo: In demo mode, Compass checks a fictional inbox and you can simulate a payment. Nothing reaches Xero, Gmail or a phone.
monitor.noTasks: No follow-ups yet. Check for replies to look for new ones.
monitor.simText: Records a payment as if Xero had confirmed it. Only invoices that had a reminder count towards Payments Recovered.
monitor.allPaid: Every reminded invoice has been paid.
monitor.paymentCounted: {{amount}} verified and added to Payments Recovered.
monitor.paymentNotCounted: Payment recorded but not counted as recovered, because no reminder had been sent for it.
monitor.xeroText: Checking for replies also reads new payments from Xero. Each payment is counted once and reminders stop when an invoice is paid.

activity.title: What Compass Has Done
activity.text: Measured results come straight from your records. Time and money saved are estimates.
activity.estimatedNote: Worked out from your settings, not measured
activity.formula: Estimate: {{invoice}} minutes per invoice reviewed plus {{family}} minutes per family contacted, at {{rate}} an hour.
activity.noEvents: Nothing yet. Start a scan on the Autonomous Recovery tab.
activity.notAttributed: Not counted: no reminder came first
activity.noMessages: No messages have gone out yet.
